items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: His daughter, me, of Jana and so on.

ctx.x: Yeah, we lived over there partly about seven or eight years.

Seven or eight years, a long time. Do you remember Oguise, the basement over there? Oguise? Yeah, yeah. He died a few years ago. I used to go over there and tell him. You did? Sure. Yeah. They had a family band. They made a little later. Yes, you know. Yeah. His daughter, me, of Jana and so on. I would like to ask you, Mr. Dale, do you remember approximately when the family moved to New Orleans from Mexico? Of course, that would be several years before you were born. And I wondered if you knew just about what…

No, sir. I wouldn't be able to tell you that. Probably I could get it for you. But I wouldn't know. Yeah, when I knew that was long before I was born, that was before my father got married. My father got married here.
